text:
sanjay: Heads up — we had a couple GPU pools hit sustained saturation this morning. Thinking about tightening key/org rate limits to tie to real-time capacity signals instead of static quotas. Wdyt?

emily: agree in principle. can we avoid dropping bursts for high-tier customers? we should keep a small grace buffer. :thinking_face:

sanjay: exactly. my rough idea: token-bucket per key/org but the refill rate is multiplied by a `capacity_factor` derived from GPU headroom in the region (0..1). also a temporary "priority credits" balance for paid tiers to allow short bursts even when capacity_factor drops.

jia: love that. couple notes: 1) capacity signal needs smoothing (ema) so transient GPU spikes don't throttle instantly. 2) define max grace window — e.g., credits can be used for N seconds while autoscaler spins up.

alex: quick pseudo for refill calc:
```
capacity_factor = clamp(available_gflops / target_headroom_gflops, 0, 1)
refill_per_sec = base_refill * (0.5 + 0.5 * capacity_factor)
# 0.5 baseline to avoid full blackout, scaled up to base_refill as capacity improves
```

emily: why the 0.5 baseline? want to make sure doesn't let unlimited traffic when capacity=0. might prefer 0.2 baseline for safety. also need per-region fallbacks.

sanjay: 0.5 was a placeholder. we should expose baseline as config per-tier. and yes per-region multipliers.

ops-bot: [alert] gpu-pool-europe-west-3: node_utilization > 92% for 12m. autoscaler queued scale-up job id=sa-4432

jia: ops-bot confirms — autoscaler will take ~30-60s to add nodes. grace credits should cover that gap. i propose:
- grace_budget_seconds = 60 for enterprise
- 20 for standard
- 0 for free (no grace)

emily: +1. also: prefer "credits bank" model where unused refill accumulates up to cap so customers get fairness over time. avoids punishing steady small traffic.

alex: implementation considerations: token-bucket stored in redis with per-key fields: tokens, last_refill_ts, priority_credits. refill job can be local per-proxy but use central capacity_pubsub to update capacity_factor per-region.

sanjay: cost question — if we let enterprise burst while autoscaler spins up, we take on short-term cost. ops needs a soft limit or billing alert.

emily: ops/finance: add metric `burst_cost_estimate` and alert when 5m rolling > $X for any org. also log when priority credits dip below threshold.

ops-bot: [note] created ticket INF-789: "Implement capacity-aware token refill + priority credits" assigned to eng-infra.

jia: TL;DR action items: 1) prototype refill formula + baseline tuning (alex) 2) capacity pubsub smoothing (sanjay) 3) grace budget caps per tier + billing alerts (emily) 4) redis schema + proxy enforcement (alex)

sanjay: thanks — i'll spin up a short doc with the formulas and expected metrics. ping me if you want to be on the design call tomorrow. :calendar:
